portal_hypertension.title: Spleen volume-to-platelet count ratio correlates with portal pressure and is associated with blood loss in laparoscopic non-anatomical hepatectomy.
portal_hypertension.authors: Kawasaki Y, Yamasaki Y, Fukuda K
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 20）。核心观点：门脉高压会增加肝切除过程中的出血风险，但直接测量在常规实践中具有侵入性且不切实际。 临床提示：因此，我们研究了脾脏体积与血小板计数比（SVPR）（一种非侵入性替代指标）是否与门静脉压力相关以及与腹腔镜肝切除术期间的失血量相关。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension increases bleeding risk during liver resection, but direct measurement is invasive and impractical in routine practice. Therefore, we investigated whether the spleen volume-to-platelet count ratio (SVPR), a non-invasive surrogate, correlates with portal pressure and is associated with blood loss during laparoscopic hepatectomy. The correlation between portal pressure and SVPR was examined in 20 patients undergoing open hepatectomy with direct portal pressure measurement. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis was used to determine the optimal SVPR cutoff for clinically significant portal hypertension (≥ 10 mmHg) with bootstrap internal validation. portal_hypertension.title: Oral anticoagulants and hepatic decompensation in patients with cirrhosis and atrial fibrillation: observational study.
portal_hypertension.authors: Wester A, Grip ET, Rajani R
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：口服抗凝剂可能会降低代偿性肝硬化患者肝功能失代偿的风险，但缺乏有力的随机试验。 临床提示：我们的目的是评估口服抗凝剂对代偿性肝硬化和心房颤动患者肝代偿失调和大出血风险的影响。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Oral anticoagulants may reduce risk of hepatic decompensation in patients with compensated cirrhosis, but well-powered randomized trials are missing. We aimed to estimate the effect of oral anticoagulants on risk of hepatic decompensation and major bleeding in patients with compensated cirrhosis and atrial fibrillation. Observational data from Swedish healthcare registers 2011-2022 were used to emulate a target trial of oral anticoagulants in patients with compensated cirrhosis and newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation.
